description:
Companion codegen bundle for vidocq-runtime-cervantes-jwt-extension.
        Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the
        application depends on the JWT extension; Maven resolves the
        transitive APT dependencies below automatically.
        Puts CervantesClaimExtension on the processor path, so that vauban-processor runs it at build time: the
        JsonWebToken and @Claim beans it declares are known when the application's injection points are checked.
